name: MCP Server
label: MCP Server
description: Calls one remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP (protocol 2025-06-18, also 2025-03-26 and 2024-11-05). Each run sends initialize, notifications/initialized, then one method, and DELETEs the session when the server issued Mcp-Session-Id. The POST response may be a JSON object or one text/event-stream body. stdio is not a mode: this node does not spawn a local process. There is no inbound listener. Auth token is password config and is never logged. Tool arguments are sent only to server_url. Daemon egress policy still applies. A tool result with isError true is success data, not a BPMN error.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One MCP call. operation and server_url override config when set. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: call_tool.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: list_tools | call_tool | list_resources | read_resource | list_resource_templates | list_prompts | get_prompt | ping. Overrides config. Blank uses config, then list_tools.

schema.label: server_url
schema.description: Absolute http or https MCP endpoint for this call. Overrides config. No userinfo. Must not contain auth_token.

schema.label: tool_name
schema.description: Tool name for call_tool. Required for that operation. Max 256 characters. No control characters.

schema.label: arguments
schema.description: JSON object passed as tools/call arguments. Omit or {} when the tool takes none. A JSON object string is accepted. Max 256 KiB.

schema.label: uri
schema.description: Resource URI for read_resource. Required for that operation. Sent to the MCP server as a string; this node does not fetch the URI itself.

schema.label: prompt_name
schema.description: Prompt name for get_prompt. Required for that operation. Max 256 characters.

schema.label: prompt_arguments
schema.description: JSON object passed as prompts/get arguments. Omit or {} when unused.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Opaque pagination cursor for list_tools, list_resources, list_resource_templates, or list_prompts. Max 1024 characters.

ports.name: output
ports.description: JSON-RPC result as {status, data, http_status}. data is the result object (tools, contents, messages, or a ping object). Errors raise a BPMN error (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED). The auth token is redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on success. EXACT value: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: JSON-RPC result object. call_tool returns the tool result, including isError when the tool itself failed. Non-object results are wrapped as {value}.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status of the method POST (not the initialize POST).

configurationParameters.label: Server URL
configurationParameters.description: Absolute http or https URL of the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint. Required unless input server_url is set. No userinfo. Example: https://mcp.example.com/mcp

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default method when input operation is blank. EXACT values: list_tools, call_tool, list_resources, read_resource, list_resource_templates, list_prompts, get_prompt, ping.

configurationParameters.label: Auth Type
configurationParameters.description: none | bearer | header. bearer sends Authorization: Bearer <auth_token>. header sends auth_header: <auth_token>. Default none.

configurationParameters.label: Auth Token
configurationParameters.description: Secret for auth_type bearer or header. Password-typed config only. Never logged. Required when auth_type is bearer or header. Not read from the input port.

configurationParameters.label: Auth Header
configurationParameters.description: Header name when auth_type=header. Default X-Api-Key. Letters, digits, and hyphen only, max 64. Host, Authorization, Content-Type, and MCP session headers are rejected.

configurationParameters.label: Protocol Version
configurationParameters.description: MCP-Protocol-Version offered in initialize. EXACT values: 2024-11-05, 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18. Default 2025-06-18. Later calls use the version the server agreed to when that version is in this list.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Budget for the whole invoke (initialize, initialized notification, method, and session DELETE). Blank, 0, or negative becomes 30. Cap 60.

configurationParameters.label: Verify TLS
configurationParameters.description: Verify the server certificate. Default true. EXACT disable value: false. Any other value verifies. false is lab-only.
